title: Mists of Releh

[[Image:MistsOfReleh.png|right|160px]]
'''Mists of Releh''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': Special

'''Sanity Cost''': 0

'''Any Phase''': Cast and exhaust to pass an [[Evade check]]. The casting modifier is equal to the [[monster]]'s [[Awareness]].
